title: Add Clear Cart button
description: As a shopper, I want a 'Clear Cart' button in the cart panel so I can empty my cart and reset any applied promo code in one click.
acceptance_criteria: When the cart has at least one item, a button with text 'Clear Cart' is visible.
Clicking 'Clear Cart' removes all items from the cart and clears the promo code.

title: Display free shipping threshold progress
description: As a shopper, I want to see how close my cart subtotal is to the $100 free shipping threshold.
acceptance_criteria: When cart subtotal is below $100, display 'Add $X.XX more for free shipping'.
When cart subtotal is $100 or more, display 'Free shipping unlocked!'.

title: Show Low Stock badge on products with 6 or fewer items
description: As a shopper, I want to see a 'Low stock' indicator on product cards when available stock is 6 or fewer.
acceptance_criteria: Products with stock > 0 and stock <= 6 display a 'Low stock' badge.
Products with stock > 6 do not display the 'Low stock' badge.

title: Sort products by price
description: As a shopper, I want to sort products by price (Low to High or High to Low) from the search bar.
acceptance_criteria: SearchBar renders a select control with aria-label 'Sort products'.
Selecting 'Price: Low to High' orders products from lowest to highest price.
Selecting 'Price: High to Low' orders products from highest to lowest price.

title: Reset search and category filters
description: As a shopper, I want a 'Reset Filters' button in the search bar to clear my search query and category filter.
acceptance_criteria: A 'Reset Filters' button is rendered in the search bar.
Clicking 'Reset Filters' resets the search query to empty and category to 'All'.

title: Show validation message for invalid promo codes
description: As a shopper, I want to see an 'Invalid promo code' message when I enter a promo code that is not recognized.
acceptance_criteria: When promoCode is non-empty and not a valid promo code, display 'Invalid promo code' in the cart.
When promoCode is empty or valid (e.g. SAVE10), do not display 'Invalid promo code'.

title: Disable Add to Cart when cart reaches product stock limit
description: As a shopper, I want the 'Add to Cart' button on a product card to be disabled and show 'Max in Cart' once I have added all available stock to my cart.
acceptance_criteria: When cart quantity for a product equals product.stock, its button text changes to 'Max in Cart' and is disabled.
Before reaching stock limit, the button remains enabled with text 'Add to Cart'.

title: Persist cart items in localStorage
description: As a shopper, I want my cart items saved in localStorage so they persist across page reloads.
acceptance_criteria: Adding or updating items saves the cart array to localStorage under key 'mockshop_cart'.
Mounting App loads initial cart items from localStorage['mockshop_cart'] if present.

title: Show itemized order details in checkout confirmation
description: As a shopper, I want the order confirmation box to show my email address and an itemized list of purchased products with quantities.
acceptance_criteria: Order confirmation displays customerEmail.
Order confirmation lists each purchased item's name and quantity (e.g. 'Mechanical Keyboard x 2').

title: Apply automatic 5% bulk discount for 5+ total items
description: As a shopper, I want an automatic 5% bulk discount when my cart has 5 or more total items, applied before any promo code discount.
acceptance_criteria: When total quantity across all cart items is >= 5, a 5% bulk discount is applied to the subtotal.
Promo code discount is calculated on the subtotal after the bulk discount.
Cart displays a 'Bulk discount (5%)' line when applicable.
